Maya K.: Heads up — running an overnight model-sweep + eval next Wed (22:00-02:00 UTC, eu-west1). We need ~12 H100s steady for batch jobs (not preemptible). Can we confirm quota and prebook with the vendor? Also noticed a billing hold flag on the account. @Jon @Casey
Jon P.: cc @Casey @Leah — checking quota now. If billing hold is real we need finance to clear. Maya can you paste the job window and a quick gcloud check?
Maya K.: Window: 22:00-02:00 UTC, job prefix `model-sweep-2026-03-11`. Quick local check I ran: ```gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --project=redwood-prod --format='json' | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'``` — looks like 8/20 H100 used (12 free) but vendor reserved/warm-pool might not be reflected.
Casey R.: I see a vendor portal billing notice — "invoice overdue" on our reserved pools. vendor-ops-bot should open a ticket.
vendor-ops-bot: Ticket VG-812 opened with CloudVendor. ETA for reserve acknowledgement 48h. Note: warm pools allocate in 4h windows.
Leah S.: @Maya can you lower max parallelism to 8 per shard as a fallback? That drops peak to 8 H100s; we can burst to 12 if vendor confirms.
Maya K.: Yep can adjust. Prefer full run if reserve clears. @Jon any chance to prebook 12 from soft-pool?
Jon P.: Filing a request now — sending vendor contact and finance cc. If they don't ack we can fall back to mixed H100+A100 with quantized model variants.
Casey R.: Pinged finance about the overdue and added a note to the PR to reduce parallelism if reserve not confirmed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-sweep/pull/342
Leah S.: Quick sanity check command: `terraform state show module.reserves.cloud_vendor_reserved` to see active reservations.
Maya K.: Thanks — I'll queue a small smoke run at 02:00 UTC to validate infra after the concurrency change.
Jon P.: Update — vendor confirmed soft-hold for 8 H100s (eu-west1). Can expand to 12 after invoice/PO clears. Casey can you send PO?
Casey R.: On it. PO sent. Vendor updated VG-812 -> awaiting finance confirmation.
vendor-ops-bot: VG-812 updated: soft-hold applied for 8 H100s (eu-west1) until 2026-03-13T08:00Z. Escalate if >8 needed.
Maya K.: Great, reducing concurrency to 8 as fallback. Thanks all :thumbsup:
